t: Erskine Records
s: Erskine Records Limited is a British independent record label founded by singer-songwriter Harry Styles in May 2016, serving primarily as the imprint for his solo music career while also signing select other artists.[1] Incorporated as a private limited company in London under the nature of business code for artistic creation (SIC 90030), it operates from a registered office at Elsley Court, 20-22 Great Titchfield Street, and maintains a presence in Los Angeles.[2] The label gained prominence through its partnership with Columbia Records, a Sony Music Entertainment division, under an exclusive licensing deal that has facilitated the release of Styles' solo albums and singles.
